Payment processing is not configured in this environment
checks.detail: No Stripe key is present, so a real subscription, renewal, refund or chargeback cannot be exercised here. The billing model and metrics API exist and are covered by other suites.

checks.name: Object storage has not been exercised
checks.detail: No R2 or S3 credentials are present. Uploads are written to local disk, which is what the upload and stress suites measured. Behaviour against remote object storage — latency, partial writes, credential expiry — is unproven.

checks.name: Email delivery has not been exercised
checks.detail: No SES credentials are present, so verification mail, invitations and notifications cannot be sent or observed from here.

checks.name: HTTPS and Cloudflare in front of a real deployment have not been validated
checks.detail: This environment has no public ingress of its own. Review has been done through a temporary tunnel, which terminates TLS elsewhere and is not the production edge. Certificate handling, WAF rules, caching and rate limiting at the edge are unproven.

checks.name: Browser compatibility beyond Chromium has not been measured
checks.detail: Every browser check in this platform runs in Chromium. Safari and Firefox are untested, which matters most for the upload portal, since directory selection and resumable upload behave differently across engines.
